messages:
diego_csm: Helios Systems (renewal in 2 months) wants to onboard a small in-house reranker (1.2B) for telemetry event deduping. They want EU-only residency, dedicated capacity during pilot, and a short PHI/PII risk assessment. Pilot target: 50k queries/day. Timeline: pilot kickoff in 6 weeks. Can we intake?

diego_csm: Customer notes: model is a full merged checkpoint (PyTorch) and they did offline evals showing +6% NDCG. They asked for an operational estimate (latency, cost), and a SOC-lite checklist for their security team.

lina_ml: Re: evals — we'll need: 500 in-domain pairs for ranking QA, 200 adversarial probes (PII extraction style), and data-leakage checks (membership inference). Also request a sample of the labeled telemetry slice (deid) to calibrate metrics.

sam_eng: Deployment questions: do they require Dedicated (yes) and autoscaling for spikes? We need the checkpoint upload to our secure intake and a sha256 for integrity. For EU residency, will run them in DUB region cluster. Canary routing + failover to hosted reranker possible.

marta_security: Security/Privacy: since telemetry contains device IDs + operator notes, enforce masking for any IDs at postprocess. Also need customer to sign the Model Usage Agreement addendum (Ill send). HSM not requested but they want key control for backups.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-4983 2D Helios Systems reranker intake. Assignees: sam_eng, lina_ml, marta_security. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-4983

lina_ml: For benchmarks: ask Helios for a 1k-sample cold-latency harness and a 5k throughput workload trace. We'll run: P50/P95 latency, tokens/sec, and memory footprint on quantized 4-bit and fp16. Expect engineering-run ETA 3 business days after sample.

sam_eng: Note: 1.2B quantizes easily; integrated adapter/merged checkpoint OK. If they want CPU fallback in DUB, that increases latency significantly; document tradeoffs.

diego_csm: I'll get the signed addendum and the checkpoint + integrity hash. Also will surface the canary idea + ask if they want A/B against hosted baseline. Helios is worried about any regression during renewal talks.

marta_security: For the SOC-lite checklist, I'll draft a 1-page with: data residency, key management (customer-owned KMS), access controls, audit logs, and incident contact. Will share by EOD tomorrow.

lina_ml: Also propose a simple acceptance SLO: NDCG lift >= 4% on validation holdout AND no PII leakage detected in adversarial probe set (we can define "no leakage" as <0.05% sensitive token recall across probes). We'll need them to accept that threshold.

sam_eng: Operational ask: provide a small infra runbook snippet for onboarding: how to upload, how to start canary, how to rollback. I'll prep that and attach to ticket.

diego_csm: Great. Customer also asked for a rough cost delta: dedicated 1xA100-equivalent pool for their load estimate. Can eng give a ballpark monthly delta so I can include it in renewal discussions?

sam_eng: Ballpark: with quantized 4-bit, were looking at ~40-60% of a full 13B node's memory/compute; rough cost estimate for their 50k q/day load during pilot: ~€6k-€9k/month. I'll refine after running the perf harness.

marta_security: Heads-up: if any PHI is present in operator notes, we may require additional contract language. Diego, confirm whether Helios considers any telemetry fields regulated.

diego_csm: Will confirm and report back.

deploy-bot: Reminder set for CS-4983: due in 42 days.

sam_eng: Next steps summary: Diego uploads checkpoint + hash + 1k latency sample + 5k trace; Marta drafts SOC-lite checklist; Lina readies eval harness; Eng will run perf & quantize test within 3 business days of receiving samples.

diego_csm: Thanks all 2D I'll coordinate with Helios and update the ticket. :thumbsup:
